title: Mini DreamBeam Silicone-Free Mineral Sunscreen SPF 40 with Ceramides and Peptides

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, nonComedogenic, zinc, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, waterResistant, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, oilFree, mineral, fragranceFree

descriptionHtml:
What it is: A clean, silicone-free, mini sunscreen, packed with ceramides and peptides, that moisturizes, visibly smooths, brightens, and creates the dreamiest makeup base.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness and Dullness

Formulation: Liquid

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mineral SPF: Protects with 21.7 percent non-nano zinc.
- Peptides and Ceramides: Visibly plumps, smooths, and improves skin suppleness.
- Hyaluronic Acid and Allantoin: Hydrates and soothes skin.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Wear alone or as the perfect base for makeup.
-Warm it with hands and smooth it all over.
-Allow SPF three to five minutes to fully absorb and set before applying makeup.
Ingredients+
-Mineral SPF: Protects with 21.7 percent non-nano zinc.
-Peptides + Ceramides: Visibly plumps, smooths, and improves skin suppleness.
-Hyaluronic Acid + Allantoin: Hydrates and soothes skin.

Zinc Oxide 21.7 %, Allantoin, Bioflavonoids, Bisabolol, Butyloctyl Salicylate, C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate, C13-15 Alkane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Ceramide NG, Disteardimonium Hectorite, DL-Alpha TocopherylAcetate, Fructooligosaccharides, Galactoarabinan, Glycerin, Glycoproteins, Guar Gum, Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Iron Oxides (CI 77492), Isostearic Acid, Lactic Acid, Lecithin, Mica, Palmitoyl Hexapeptide-12, Pentylene Glycol, Phenethyl Alcohol, Phytic Acid, Polyglyceryl-2 Dipolyhydroxystearate, Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate, Polyglyceryl-3 Polyricinoleate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid,Propanediol, Silica, Sodium Chloride, Sodium Hyaluronate, Titanium Dioxide (CI77891), Tribehenin, Water/Aqua/Eau, Xanthan Gum.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
